Hivetune has released Marimbox, a virtual marimba instrument for macOS and Windows that features stereo-sampled acoustic recordings and built-in effects. The free edition includes four playing styles—Cord, Deadstroke, Rubber, and Yarn—along with envelope controls and up to 64 voices of polyphony.

A $4.99 Complete Edition adds a sustained roll articulation, while the free version provides access to the core sound engine, attack and release faders, and echo and reverb effects. The plugin operates as a VST3, AU, and standalone application.

entry.title: HoRNet FilterSolo Plugin Available Free for Limited Time
entry.content:
Links: bedroomproducersblog.com

HoRNet Plugins is offering its FilterSolo resonant filter plugin for free for a limited time until November 1. Users can obtain the plugin by applying a promotional code at checkout on the developer's website.

FilterSolo features analog-style saturation, extensive modulation options, and multi-mode filtering capabilities for macOS and Windows in standard plugin formats. The plugin is normally a paid product and supports common digital audio workstations for music production.

entry.title: DAWJunkie Releases Jack Johnsynth Free Vocal Hybrid Synth
entry.content:
Links: bedroomproducersblog.com | dawjunkie.com

DAWJunkie has released Jack Johnsynth, a free vocal hybrid synthesizer plugin available for macOS and Windows. The virtual instrument comes in VST, AU, and AAX formats, expanding the developer's lineup of quirky freeware tools that includes releases like Drumbo Jr and Padness 2 Jr.

The plugin is designed to produce unique vocal-inspired hybrid sounds for music producers. It is available to download directly from the official DAWJunkie website.
